# Phase One — Five Competing Designs

> Five vessels face one light; the Awtsmoos.com architecture chooses the vessel that keeps every authority truthful and bright.

## A — Replace everything with a new Definition Graph

**Pros:** clean theoretical start.  
**Cons:** duplicates mature schemas, breaks compatibility, creates migration catastrophe, discards tested world/history/Reality/Nature systems.  
**Verdict:** reject.

## B — Expand Creation Portal from six verbs to the whole universe

**Pros:** existing semantic doorway.  
**Cons:** tests intentionally lock its six-verb contract; adding world transactions/history would blur responsibilities.  
**Verdict:** reject.

## C — Make Procedural Portal the only public API

**Pros:** already has world-scale validation/planning/explanation/compile.  
**Cons:** does not naturally expose transactional `awtsmoos.world.v1` command/history API and changes the meaning of a mature facade.  
**Verdict:** reject as sole doorway.

## D — Add an unrelated new top-level package/folder

**Pros:** isolates dependencies.  
**Cons:** creates the exact second “universal API” the project archaeology warns against; requires new package export and migration surface.  
**Verdict:** reject unless dependency cycles force it.

## E — Additive convergence inside existing `core/universalApi`

Create `createAwtsmoos()` and an `Awtsmoos` facade that compose:
- Universal Semantic Kernel for portable definitions and compiler federation;
- canonical definition validator;
- Procedural Portal for explainable world-scale planning/compile federation;
- existing `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()` for transactions/history/world document commands;
- serializable pipeline/discovery metadata.

**Pros:** one package surface, no new language, old APIs untouched, simple outside/immense inside, additive migration, existing root exports automatically expose it.  
**Cons:** must guard dependency direction and clearly name expert namespaces.  
**Verdict:** WINNER.

## Winner constraints

- No semantic vocabulary duplication.
- No top-level method sprawl beyond five lifecycle verbs.
- No fake compiler support.
- No mutations of the stable Creation Portal method set.
- No replacement of `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()`.
